description:
What happens when you connect the dots?  This changed how I see dog training forever. 

Much of our history of partnering with and training dogs runs through conquest, slave-catching, colonial enforcement, military programs, police work, prisons, and the weaponization of dogs against both humans and other animals.

That doesn’t mean every modern trainer supports those things.

But it does mean we should ask a difficult question:
